description: Evaluates the content pipeline workflow from ideation through publication and monitoring, ensuring SEO, brand, and platform standards are maintained at every stage.

criteria.question: Are content ideas scored by trend relevance? (yes/no)
Does blog copy follow SEO best practices? (yes/no)
Are social captions platform-specific in tone and length? (yes/no)
